name: length_myFilter_le
prelude:
def myFilter (p : α → Bool) : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => if p x then x :: myFilter p xs else myFilter p xs
statement: theorem length_myFilter_le (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) : (myFilter p xs).length ≤ xs.length
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myFilter]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [myFilter]
    split <;> simp <;> omega
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact Nat.le_refl 0
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases h : p x with
    | true =>
      simp only [myFilter, h, ↓reduceIte, List.length_cons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ ih
    | false =>
      simp only [myFilter, h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.length_cons]
      exact Nat.le_succ_of_le ih
